notes: Weapon balance: every firearm, unique and melee weapon is scored by expected damage per turn over a full reload cycle (one attack per turn, reload = Action +2 / Bonus +1, vs AC 14 at +5). Target curve: ~8-10 per turn for street gear rising steeply to ~50 for the top tier; melee +15%, uniques +10%. 64 of 115 weapons were outside +/-15% and had dice scaled within their die type (class identity kept). Magazines, reloads and every manufacturer trait unchanged.

Big single-shot snipers keep nutty alpha: Nekomata 5d20+70, Sunlance 1d20+102, Grad 1d20+68, Rasetsu 7d20+26 (was 8d20+30). Silverhand 1d30+61 (was +75). Errata 15d8, Chainsword Legendary 11d10. Street pistols/knives raised to ~9 per turn. Neurotoxin Knife 4d6 (poison effect carries the rest).
Prices follow power: every weapon's power rating is re-derived from its final damage, so price = 150 + 7 x rating^1.75 (x rarity multiplier).

Armor: AC per Mk capped at 21 (heavy 15-21, medium 13-19, light 12-17 + full DEX); prices and power ratings scale with AC. Bastion Take the Bullet 3/5/7/9/12. Flexweave Grenade Null halves grenade damage at Mk I-IV, immunity at Mk V.
Grenades: damage by Mk (Mk1 4d6, Mk2 6d6, Mk3 8d6, Mk4 10d6; EMP one step lighter; Ozob's Nose 10d6); prices by Mk with sticky x1.3, homing x1.6, utility x0.4.
Quickhacks: Arc Overload 12d12 -> 8d10. Consumables: Neural Adaptation Kit limited to once per character (GM-enforced text).
Joke weapons (Slaughtomatic, Dildo Stout, Shovel Caretaker) and all cyberware untouched.
